label: reconstructed from public reports
source: FATF and Egmont Group (2020), Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments, FATF, Paris. https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Methodsandtrends/Trade-based-money-laundering-trends-and-developments.html
what_happened: Accounts of two brothers running motor-vehicle firms showed activity first suspected as a false-invoicing network; vehicle-sale proceeds went to Middle Eastern import/export companies.
reconstruction: Export invoices for cars with no matching bill of lading (invoices without shipments). This is an interpretation of 'false invoicing'; the box gives no document details.
